description.value: Community-run electric minibus service operating a South End loop through Sturdies Bay, the Marina, the Saturday Market, Library, Daystar Market, and Montague Park, plus a by-request North End route on Galiano Island. Fare is $5 CAD per trip. Public service runs Friday afternoons/evenings and Saturday mornings, with weekday school-run trips also open to the public and Sunday service by advance request (email galianobus@gmail.com by 9pm the day before). No bike policy is published — contact galianobus@gmail.com before travel to confirm whether a bike can be carried.

wow_evidence: Community-run electric minibus service on Galiano Island operating scheduled transit, meeting arriving ferries
